messages:
sanjay: Heads up — onboarding new org 'orpheus' (enterprise). Need cross-cloud account provisioning checklist + GPU quota increases across AWS/GCP/Azure. Putting a concise checklist below, pls call out anything missing.

elaine: Good call. Do we have target GPU counts per cloud/region?

sanjay: Initial ask — targets for MVP: AWS p4d: 8 instances (us-west-2), GCP A2 (a100) total 12 GPUs split us-west1/europe-west4, Azure ND A100_v4: 8 GPUs in westeurope. Also request burst capacity for spikes + quota for static external IPs and LB forwarding rules. Budget estimate ~ $100-140k/month peak.

todd: For GCP we'll provision a dedicated project `orpheus-prod`. Steps I follow:
```
# create project
gcloud projects create orpheus-prod --set-as-default --name="Orpheus Prod"
# enable APIs
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com --project=orpheus-prod
# create service account
gcloud iam service-accounts create orpheus-infer-sa --project=orpheus-prod --display-name="Orpheus inference SA"
```
Also open quota request: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas (choose "GPUs (all regions)") and link to the support case with accelerators=a2.

maria: IAM & billing notes:
- Create groups: `g-orpheus-infra-admin`, `g-orpheus-billing`, `g-orpheus-sre`
- Grant `roles/compute.admin` only to infra admin group; use least privilege for others
- Service account: `orpheus-infer-sa@orpheus-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with key rotation via KMS
- Billing: attach existing enterprise billing account `BILL-ORPHEUS` and set spending alerts (thresholds: 50k/100k)

infra-bot: Tag enforcement: reminder — tag keys required on all cloud resources: `team`, `env`, `product`, `cost_center`. Example: `team:inference`, `env:prod`, `product:orpheus`, `cost_center:AI-42`.

elaine: Networking checklist:
- Create VPC `orpheus-prod-vpc` with non-overlapping CIDR to prod (pick 10.40.0.0/16)
- Request VPC peering to `redwood-prod-main` and set up route export/import
- Request additional static IP quota: 50 regional external IPs (we currently have 20 cap)
- Increase load balancer forwarding-rules quota to 25 per region

sanjay: Quick template for cloud support ticket (copy/paste):

"We are onboarding a new enterprise org 'Orpheus' (customer id: ORP-9001). Requesting GPU quota increases and networking limits to support inference fleet: AWS (p4d) x8 in us-west-2, GCP (A2/A100) 12 GPUs split across us-west1/europe-west4, Azure ND A100_v4 x8 in westeurope. Also request increase of Regional External IP quota to 50 and LB forwarding rules to 25. This is for production inference; expected sustained usage starts MM/DD. Contact: sanjay@redwood.com, ops ticket ORP-ONB-001."

elaine: For AWS, open a support case with the exact instance type and AZ distribution. Tag the case with priority=business_critical if finance signs off.

todd: I'll take AWS quota, will open case: AWS-12345.
maria: I'll attach billing & IAM tasks and set up groups.
sanjay: I'll open GCP/Azure tickets: GCP-67890, AZ-24680. ETA 48-72h for quota approvals, will escalate to cloud reps if we hit delays.

elaine: Also confirm we'd like preemptible/spot fallback for cost savings — propose configuring autoscale groups with mixed instances and a minimum reserved baseline.

sanjay: Agreed. Plan: provision reserved capacity for baseline (p4d x2, a100 x4, nd x2), allow burst via quota and spot pools. I'll add cost estimates to the tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/orpheus-onboard (will grant access to g-orpheus-billing).

infra-bot: Action items assigned — todd: AWS quota case, elaine: network peering & IP quota, maria: IAM/billing, sanjay: support tickets + cost doc.

sanjay: Thanks — will update thread with ticket numbers and PR checklist as items move. :rocket:
